study_meta.region_raw: China (outside Hubei Province); selected provinces/cities: Hubei, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Zhejiang, Henan
study_meta.period_raw: December 29, 2019 – March 31, 2020 (data collection as of March 31, 2020); R0 estimated Jan 21–Jan 28; Rc estimated Jan 29–Feb 5
study_meta.population_raw: Confirmed COVID-19 cases outside Hubei Province in China
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 14,829 confirmed cases; 645 chains of transmission identified; 198 chains with dates of symptoms onset available; 139 dates of infections identified; 169 cases with identifiable dates of infection
study_meta.method_raw: Contact tracing and transmission chain inference from publicly available data from provincial/municipal health commissions; serial interval calculated from 198 transmission pairs with symptom onset dates; generation time not calculated due to insufficient infection dates

parameter_mentions.evidence: Section 3: 'very few of them have their dates of infection acquired...Hence, we only calculate the serial interval but not the generation time'
